name: peace lily
fact: not a real lily at all. it droops dramatically when thirsty, then jumps right back up after a drink, scared me a lot the first time.
care: drinks about once a week, likes bright indirect light, leaves collect dust and need wiping now and then.

name: calathea
fact: also called the peacock plant. its leaves fold up at night and open again in the morning.
care: likes lightly moist soil, filtered water and humid air, direct sun burns its leaves.

name: silvery ann
fact: not a real pothos, even though everyone calls it one. the silver spots are tiny air pockets that catch the light.
care: soil should dry out between drinks, does well in medium light, curling leaves mean it is thirsty.
